title: Horizon Months Already Run Under an Approved Repayment Plan — Benefit Debts and Overpayment Recovery Training Note
content:
On a debt in **Benefit Debts and Overpayment Recovery** that has had a repayment plan approved, part of the repayment horizon is treated as already run when the amount a waiver request asks VA to waive is measured.

## Rule

- **Plan approved, debt back in active collection.** When a repayment plan on the debt was approved and the debt is again in active collection, the whole calendar months from that plan's approval to today are taken out of the horizon.
- **Plan approved, debt still in a plan.** When a plan was approved and the debt is still in repayment-plan status, one month is taken out of the horizon.
- **No plan ever approved.** No month is taken out under this rule.

The approval is a granted repayment plan decision on the debt; where there is more than one, the latest decides the date. Whole calendar months count a month once the day of the month of the approval date is reached again. The debt's status is read from the debt record.

## Training questions (hypothetical records)

**A plan was granted on 10 February and cancelled; the debt is active again; today is 25 July. What is taken out?** The whole months from 10 February to 25 July: 5.

**Same, but today is 5 July?** 10 July has not been reached, so 4 months.

**A plan was granted and the debt is still in repayment-plan status?** One month, whatever the date of approval.

**A plan was requested but never granted?** Nothing is taken out; only a granted plan decision counts.

| Granted plan decision on the debt | Debt status now | Months taken out of the horizon |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Active | Whole months from approval to today |
| Yes | Repayment plan | 1 |
| No | Any | None |
